accent.$description: Accent of agent-authored content; always with the agent icon and label (UX.PATTERN). The value here is the light binding; every theme binds it in tokens/themes/.

surface.$description: Background of agent-authored proposals. The value here is the light binding; every theme binds it in tokens/themes/.

text.$description: Text that labels agent-authored content. The value here is the light binding; every theme binds it in tokens/themes/.

strong.$description: Boundaries of inputs and controls. The value here is the light binding; every theme binds it in tokens/themes/.

subtle.$description: Decorative dividers (no contrast obligation). The value here is the light binding; every theme binds it in tokens/themes/.

claimed.$description: Dashed outline around a claimed value. A claimed value never looks measured: in every theme this role uses a hue ramp that no measured-value or brand-tier role uses, stays at least 0.10 in OKLab from every measured, brand-tier and status role, and is always shown with the word 'claimed' (UNC.UEC.CLASS). The value here is the light binding; every theme binds it in tokens/themes/.

ring.$description: Keyboard focus indicator. The value here is the light binding; every theme binds it in tokens/themes/.
